name: Card Reader
summary: Countertop payment terminal with keypad, small screen and a card in the slot; use for shop payment scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the terminal stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the terminal is hero size, about 320 px wide and 540 px tall with the card

params.name: anim
params.note: process = progress bar fills, keys light in turn, status LED blinks
